next_action.rationale: The root cause is confirmed: rule set v18 routes orders to a carrier/lane with confirmation latency exceeding the slot window, causing immediate blockage. Reverting v18 will reroute affected orders away from split-reservation logic, allowing them to clear pickup slots. This is a reversible action within the single-action authorization limit. Once reverted, the 186 orders can resume normal progression. Post-incident: Carrier Operations must investigate and resolve the elevated confirmation latency on split-reservation lanes before v18 can be safely re-deployed.

Root cause is established and confirmed by revert evidence: East-node carrier confirmation latency (median 47 minutes) exceeds the pickup slot window (30 minutes), causing orders to expire before carrier confirmation. Rule v18 is not the defect but a trigger that routes more orders to the affected east-node path. Mitigation: Escalate to Carrier Operations to investigate and resolve the elevated confirmation latency on the east-node carrier system. Once resolved, rule v18 can be safely re-deployed and the 186 original orders can be re-allocated.
